column1: # Camera Raw's default exposure offset per camera body, for DNG Standard
#   make <TAB> model|alias|alias <TAB> offset in EV <TAB> lowest native ISO (or empty)
# From RAWmakase data/cameras.toml: make, model, aliases, baseline_exposure,
# lowest_iso and levels of every row. Names are LibRaw's, matched to rawler's in
# Generated - never edit the rows by hand. scripts/rawmakase-cameras.mjs writes
# them from one RAWmakase release, named on the next line, and holds the list of
# any values of ours that differ from it, each with its reason.
# Source: RAWmakase data/cameras.toml @ 151fdf86ecbdf917fe85f3cccdcd29848c4118d7 (v0.4.6), 280 bodies across 10 makes, 0 exceptions
# Each value is the BaselineExposure Camera Raw gives an unedited photo with
# Adobe Standard. The first version of this table carried RAWmakase's adjustment
# for LibRaw's white level; RAWmakase 0.4.0 dropped it when it began reading
# Levels (Canon): Adobe takes a Canon's white level by ISO speed and moves its
# BaselineExposure with it, so the picture stays referenced to the samples' full
# range. The row's levels are those of the sample its offset was read from; a
# photo whose black and white, as rawler decodes them, take another part of that
# range takes the difference (mods/dng_standard.rs, white_shift; RAWmakase's
# Because the shift uses the levels the photo is actually scaled by, it holds
# whichever white level the decoder picks (rawler: SpecularWhiteLevel).
